scene:
An immense horizontal band stretching right across the panel, almost all of it dark and empty, with one hair-thin brilliantly lit slice near the middle — and a tiny human figure standing looking only at that one thin slice.

No text or lettering anywhere.

An ordinary living room, and passing straight through the walls and through the seated person a set of long invisible ripples drawn as faint pencil arcs — radio waves crossing a room nobody can see.

No text or lettering anywhere.

That man sitting upright with his eyes closed, and around his whole body a doughnut-shaped field drawn as fine concentric lines pouring up out of his chest, over his head, down around him and back in underneath — the heart at the exact centre of it, drawn as the engine that makes the field rather than a pump.

No text or lettering anywhere.
likeness: The SECOND attached image is the character in this scene.

scene:

No text or lettering anywhere.

scene:
A dark bedroom seen from directly above — a person lying flat on their back, wide awake, eyes open, entirely unable to move, the stillness of the body drawn as absolute.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A dark bedroom seen from directly above, a person lying flat on their back wide awake and unable to move with a single long slow rolling wave line travelling across it at the level of the sleeper's head — the wave enormous and unhurried, and beside it a small clock face whose hand has almost stopped.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A dark bedroom seen from directly above, a person lying flat on their back on the bed, and the long slow rolling wave line travelling across the room at the level of their head suddenly spiking into fast jagged teeth as fear takes hold, and the luminous figure being snapped back down into the body like a released elastic.

No text or lettering anywhere.

That man sitting upright with his eyes closed, and the doughnut-shaped field of fine concentric lines around his whole body thinned out to just a few faint lines, and the luminous figure now loose inside the body, half lifted, shoulders and head already clear of it.

No text or lettering anywhere.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A very close view of that man's two hands held up in front of his own face and rubbing together, and he is staring at them — testing whether they are solid, and finding that they are.

scene:
A cat sitting bolt upright on a floor, staring hard and steadily at an empty corner of the room, its eyes fixed on something the viewer cannot see.

No text or lettering anywhere.

An ordinary living room with a person seated in an armchair, but now drawn with everything that was invisible made visible at once — figures standing about, ripples, shapes and presences filling the whole space between the furniture.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A person drawn as a desktop computer's tower and screen with a human silhouette inside the casing, and out of the back of it a single cable running away into a vast web of lines that fills the rest of the panel — the body as the computer, the field as everything it is plugged into.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A man on a telephone, and in the air around his head, visible to the viewer but not to him, a small scene floating fully formed — striped Moroccan tents pitched on a lawn with lanterns strung between them.

No text or lettering anywhere.

Two glass jars of cooked rice standing side by side on a kitchen shelf, one clean and pale and just beginning to ferment, the other darkened and furred over with mould, thirty days between them.

No text or lettering anywhere.

One house drawn twice, side by side within the panel — on the left lived in, upright, warm and whole; on the right the identical house six months empty, the roof sagging, the paint gone, weeds through the step.

No text or lettering anywhere.

Water being made to turn — a stone channel spiralling it into a vortex, and rising off the moving water a ring of fine field lines.

No text or lettering anywhere.

An enormous drawn strand of DNA filling the panel, and at each end of it a small cap, one cap intact and bright, the other frayed and worn down to nothing.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A balloon high up in an open sky with a copper wire wound around it, the wire running all the way down to a metal rod driven into the ground, and a faint charge crawling down the length of the wire.

No text or lettering anywhere.
